unit_tests.case: Posting blocked when no assessment exists
unit_tests.expected: Posting is refused; message E-12 is raised
unit_tests.notes: Spec expects a hard block (E-12). The code warns with TYPE 'W', so the user can press Enter and continue. The DD-04 block was retired in r38 - see FINDINGS Disable Change Document.md. Spec row predates that change.

unit_tests.case: Concurrent posting on the same assessment - lock collision
unit_tests.expected: User B is refused while user A holds the lock

evidence.code: IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Assessment is locked by another user.' TYPE 'E'.

unit_tests.notes: The lock is requested and sy-subrc is handled, so the mechanism exists. Whether B is actually refused depends on real lock timing and cannot be settled from source.
test_steps: Two SAP sessions, users A and B, same company code and vendor
A opens ZEXAMPLE for assessment key 1000/0001000123/INV-001/2026-09-01 and stops before Save
B opens the same key and presses Save
Expect B to receive 'Assessment is locked by another user.' as an E message
Check SM12 for lock object EZFI_WHT_ASSMT while A holds it
